text:
Noah: Quick preflight: aiming to ship 'condensed-help-text' (service: rn-help) on 2026-05-15 01:45 UTC. Draft RN here: https://internal/redwood/rn/condensed-help-2026-05-15.md. Canary in us-east, then eu. Need pin + rollback owners and someone to draft the internal blurb.

Isha: I can take pin ownership. Target image rn-help:v0.9.4-q5. I'll stage image by 01:10 UTC.

Ben: Ops: recommend 10m canary us-east-1 then 15m eu-west-1. Auto-rollout should halt if 5xxs > 0.8% sustained for 3m OR p95 > baseline * 1.25. Fallback to v0.9.2.

Noah: Adding to RN: explicit rollback command, contact list (eng-oncall + eng-sre + product-ops), and a short impact paragraph for support. Also include token delta: about -0.3 tok/op.

Helena: I'll draft the internal blurb. Suggested copy: "Deploying condensed help text to reduce verbosity; monitoring latency and error rates during canary. Ping eng-oncall for regressions." Thoughts?

Isha: LGTM. I'll paste the deploy command here so Sam can wire smoke checks.

DeployBot: deploybot: queued rn-help image rn-help:v0.9.4-q5 -> staging. Use:
```
/deploy rn-help --image=rn-help:v0.9.4-q5 --env=prod --canary=10m --pin=false
```

Ben: Ops rollback snippet to add to RN:
```
# rollback to stable
/deploy rn-help --image=rn-help:v0.9.2 --env=prod --force --reason="rollback: perf or error spike"
```

Grace: Oncall for the window. Smoke tests I'll run: GET /health -> 200; POST /v1/help prompt "smoke" assert tokens < 140 and latency < 450ms. Wire those into deploy CI.

Noah: Internal announcement plan: post to #eng and #support 10 minutes after deploy start; product will get a short note after full rollout. Helena will post to #eng; I'll take #support.

Helena: I'll queue the internal blurb in docs/announce-drafts/condensed-help-internal.txt.

DeployBot: deploy started at 1799999960 (status: canary running) — https://deployboard/redwood/1799999960

Grace: First 4m: smoke tests pass, p95 +7%, error_rate 0.2%. No action.

Ben: Watching infra metrics; transient GC pause on one pod caused a 502, autoscaler recycled it, recovered quickly. No sustained errors.

Isha: Canary healthy at 10m, expanding to eu-west for 15m.

DeployBot: expanded canary to eu-west at 1799999980 (status: canary expanded).

Grace: eu-west saw a 5xx blip on a single host but resolved after pod restart. Overall errors 0.45% during that interval.

Noah: Given recovery, proceed to pin at 70% and observe 10m.

DeployBot: partial pin applied at 1799999986 (pin=70%).

Helena: Posting internal blurb to #eng now (short note + runbook link). Noah will post to #support after we hit 100%.

Isha: Pin locked to v0.9.4-q5 in console at 1799999990. 

Ben: Ops final: set fallback to v0.9.2 if 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m. Alerts escalated to oncall.

DeployBot: rollout completed at 1799999996 (status: success, rollout 100%). Summary: us-east 10m -> eu-west 15m -> staged expansion -> 100% complete.

Noah: Nice work. Reminder: update customer-facing RN with rollback snippet and token delta before external blast. I'll post support message now with the impact line.

Helena: I'll follow up with copy edits to external RN and send to legal if we touch SLA language.

Grace: Archiving run logs and attaching canary snapshot to this thread. If there are regressions, run the rollback command above and ping #eng-oncall immediately.

Noah: Closing thread  great job everyone."
